qa_pairs.question: What type of front bumper is shown in this diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: This diagram shows the front bumper survey for the solid plastic version.

qa_pairs.question: What component is labeled as number 2 in the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Component number 2 is the impact absorber.

qa_pairs.question: What are the rubber guards identified as in this front bumper assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The rubber guards are identified as component number 5 in the assembly.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the bracket on side panel located in relation to other components?
qa_pairs.answer: The bracket on side panel (component 7) is located on the right side of the bumper assembly near the mounting area.

qa_pairs.question: What is the part number shown at the bottom of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The part number shown at the bottom of the diagram is 30 51 823.

qa_pairs.question: Which component serves as the cover for the towing eye?
qa_pairs.answer: Component number 6 serves as the cover for the towing eye.

qa_pairs.question: What is the main structural component that holds the bumper panel?
qa_pairs.answer: The bumper carrier (component 3) is the main structural component that holds the bumper panel.

qa_pairs.question: How many different components are labeled in this front bumper assembly diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: There are 7 different components labeled in this front bumper assembly diagram, numbered 1 through 7.
